## Candidate Summary

Nitish Prasad is a product leader focused on 0->1 product strategy, scaled AI systems, marketplace economics, RAG, AI evaluation, trust and safety, and product operations.

Flagship work includes an anonymized AI seller workflow intelligence case study; SproutRoute, a hybrid AI travel planner with deterministic and verified data layers; Sprout Math, a privacy-first offline iOS learning app; and an implemented enterprise AI platform portfolio spanning governed model access, GraphRAG, agent observability, adversarial release gates, and MCP execution.
